paper.title_en: On the Classical, Penrose, and Reverse Isoperimetric Inequalities in Black Holes: Insights From AdS to Flat Riemannian Backgrounds
paper.abstract_en: A collection of evidence is presented showing that the conjectured reverse isoperimetric inequality (RII) for asymptotically anti-de Sitter (AdS) as well as de Sitter (dS) black holes, ${\cal R}_\text{RII} \ge 1$, is of fundamental importance and its violation (${\cal R}_\text{RII} < 1$) gives rise to either thermodynamic instabilities, or physically unreasonable solutions, or naked singularities. We show that AdS black holes violating reverse isoperimetric inequality, known as superentropic black holes, satisfy neither mechanical stability requirement of ${κ_T} \geqslant {κ_S} \geqslant 0$ nor thermal stability requirement of ${C_P} \geqslant {C_V} \geqslant 0$. This property makes them thermodynamically unstable for the whole range of parameter space and explains all the diverse behaviors so far reported. We conjecture this statement holds for all superentropic black holes. We confirm that there is no counterexample to the thermodynamic instability conjecture of superentropic black holes and extend this to dS space by presenting the first example of superentropicity in dS space. By bringing evidence, we then propose two other conjectures: 1) there is no asymptotically flat limit of superentropic black holes, and 2) there exist two stronger versions of Penrose isoperimetric inequality (PII) for asymptotically flat black holes; the first is the asymptotically flat limit of the RII and the second is a new inequality in terms of the ADM mass and the thermodynamics volume, that we call thermo-volumetric inequality, obtained via insights from the $Λ\to 0$ limit of extended black hole thermodynamics in AdS. We show that the Penrose isoperimetric inequality (PII) is weaker than the reverse isoperimetric inequality (RII), as demonstrated explicitly for $D=4,5$ and for all black hole families we have examined.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文围绕黑洞热力学与等周不等式猜想展开，涉及反等周不等式、Penrose等周不等式、超熵黑洞、扩展黑洞热力学及AdS/dS/渐近平坦背景，理论上具有较强深度，提出多个可检验猜想，与黑洞热力学及广义相对论基础主题高度相关，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 论黑洞中的经典、Penrose与反等周不等式：从AdS到平坦黎曼背景的洞见
decision.abstract_zh: 本文呈现了一系列证据，表明对于渐近反德西特（AdS）以及德西特（dS）黑洞，所猜想的反等周不等式（RII）${\cal R}_\text{RII} \ge 1$ 具有根本重要性，而对其的违反（${\cal R}_\text{RII} < 1$）会导致热力学不稳定性、物理上不合理的解，或者裸奇点。我们表明，违反反等周不等式的AdS黑洞，即所谓的超熵黑洞，既不满足机械稳定性要求 ${κ_T} \geqslant {κ_S} \geqslant 0$，也不满足热稳定性要求 ${C_P} \geqslant {C_V} \geqslant 0$。这一性质使它们在全部参数范围内热力学不稳定，并解释了迄今为止所报道的全部多种行为。我们猜想这一论断对所有超熵黑洞都成立。我们确认，对于超熵黑洞的热力学不稳定性猜想不存在反例，并通过给出dS空间中超熵性的首个例子，将其推广到dS空间。通过提供证据，我们随后提出另外两个猜想：1）超熵黑洞不存在渐近平坦极限；2）对于渐近平坦黑洞，存在两个更强版本的Penrose等周不等式（PII）；第一个是RII的渐近平坦极限，第二个是依据ADM质量和热力学体积给出的一个新不等式，我们称之为热体积不等式，它是通过从AdS中扩展黑洞热力学的$Λ\to 0$极限获得的洞见得到的。我们表明，Penrose等周不等式（PII）弱于反等周不等式（RII），这一点在我们所考察的$D=4,5$以及所有黑洞族中得到了明确展示。
